meta.note: Tokens the app needs that the claude.ai design system (tokens.json, copied verbatim) does not define. Same format; values may alias tokens.json. When the design system gains one of these, delete it here: the generator fails on duplicates.

tokens.name: color.map.basemap.building
tokens.usage: Building footprints on the self-hosted vector basemap.

tokens.name: color.map.basemap.railway
tokens.usage: Railway lines on the self-hosted vector basemap.

tokens.name: color.map.basemap.boundary
tokens.usage: Administrative boundaries on the self-hosted vector basemap.

tokens.name: color.map.mask
tokens.usage: Dims the map outside the round's area, at opacity.mask.

tokens.name: size.map.measure-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the dots of the measure line (dotted 0/6, Map overlays).

tokens.name: camera.zoom
tokens.usage: Initial zoom before the camera fits the area.

tokens.name: camera.area-detail-zoom
tokens.usage: Area picker: from this zoom the map shows neighbourhoods instead of districts.

tokens.name: camera.fit-padding-x
tokens.usage: Side padding when fitting the area or the reveal.
